scope: Focused native-shot/interception-effect/aim-correction mechanism trace only, not complete AEGIS source evaluation. Three PBO inventories preserved; ten named SQF files fully read. Other source functions were located only, not reviewed.
executionTrace: OnSystemFired matches exact gunner turret and weapon to a short-lived capture receipt; absent context leaves ordinary fire unmodified. Launcher captures attempt setMissileTarget and start an interceptor observer; gun captures start round observation and every third eligible spot sample.

CIWS rounds and missile observers compare swept projectile/target relative segments against configured radius/body geometry and minimum arming distance. Missing-projectile handling may extrapolate its last-frame segment before evaluating a hit.

InterceptHit delegates munition destruction to destroyMunition -> detonate -> triggerAmmo; submunition carriers mark interception and suppress child payload. Nearby tracked munitions can also be detonated via blastMunitions radius checks.

Launcher targeting changes missile target after native shot. This is not a proof that native fireAtTarget/collision alone can provide the same result, nor proof the engine universally requires scripted detonation.

CIWSSpot estimates bounded lead/elevation bias by ammo and target class from sampled misses, applies decay and outlier rejection, and retains four burst summaries. This is aim calibration, distinct from simulated hit/fuze effects.

intentDispositions.selection: Requires native shot capture and measured armed closest-pass evidence plus a deliberate game fuze/effect policy; a command/request or projectile disappearing is not success.
intentDispositions.constraint: No unconditional target deletion/detonation from a target flag or distance to shooter. Scripted fuse based on a real qualifying shot is a separate implementation decision, not automatically rejected as all script physics.

intentDispositions.selection: Ammo/class-scoped decayed correction and rejection of outliers are useful. Preserve authored AI skill; calibrating aim must not rewrite mission skill or make every round hit.
intentDispositions.constraint: Actual gun aim application, detection uncertainty and current weapon station remain to trace before implementation.

aimAndFireTrace20261021.scope: Focused additional aim/fire and urgency trace. assignEngagements and engagementLoop located/searched only, not fully reviewed. This does not complete the whole AEGIS review.
evidence: AimWeapon applies class-scoped decayed lead/elevation correction to a predicted ASL aim point. It offsets the optic camera relative to barrel origin, requests lockTurret, then observes barrel angular error and feasibility before ciwsGate. Launcher branches account for slew/off-bore cone and cache launch path clearance for0.5s.

LockTurret invokes lockCameraTo on turret locality or remoteExecCall to turretOwner. It is deliberate turret point control, not an ordinary native AI doTarget request. A copied persistent false temporary argument would require exact baseline/owned-lock cleanup and newer player/Zeus-lock protection.

FireWeapon may setGroupOwner to server for remote AI groups and optionally replenish ammunition. Those source authority/ammo methods are not selected for CBE. Source reliability is a random skipped cycle, not preservation of mission-authored skill or proven human-like reaction.

FireWeapon binds a short-lived capture to actual turret and weapon before BIS_fnc_fire or CIWS burst. The delayed missing-shot check retires capture/round bookkeeping; dispatch return1 is not proof of a projectile. OnSystemFired and downstream observers provide separate evidence.

CIWSBurst uses a zero-interval PFH per burst, current turret aim proof no older than0.5s, barrel minimum elevation and loaded weaponState before native UseMagazine action. Superseded burst, ammo depletion, expired duration, target/platform loss or stale engagement heartbeat stop the PFH. It later summarises consumed ammo and measured round misses, not an independent physical hit proof.

TimeToImpact ballistic branch solves time to protected position altitude using vertical velocity and gravity; it does not test horizontal intercept/impact proximity. Nonballistic branch projects velocity toward nearest protected point. Neither alone proves an impact threat. Do not copy altitude-only urgency into layered defence.

primarySemantics.fact: Command is local to turret gunner. Alternative syntax controls non-stabilised turrets; temporary true releases after target/limit reached. A point lock needs its own finite authority and exact handback.
Readback can be no value, object or ASL position. Do not assume an array-only or object-only lock baseline.
Local command triggers ammunition as if hit and can release submunitions. A shot-derived fuse/effect policy must deliberately handle that; unconditional use cannot supply safe interception.
Native event includes target, ammo, firing vehicle, instigator and missile. Warning receipt is sensing evidence, not a native shot/intercept result.

urgencyCounterexample.conclusion: Source reports imminent altitude crossing while the ballistic trajectory is more than10km away and moving farther away; altitude crossing alone must not promote immediate impact priority.

aimAndFireTrace20261021.implementationDecision: Do not extend current aircraft gunnery by treating a projectile as an ordinary Air target or warning as an interception. Required execution chain is finite current-turret aim ownership -> actual station shot capture -> bounded coalesced projectile closest-pass observation -> armed qualifying effect policy -> exact cleanup. Detection and allocation remain separate inputs. No code copied, no new controller or executable change in this review.
aimAndFireTrace20261021.nextConcreteWork: Implement that shot/aim lifecycle on the existing current-owner scheduler and fire-task boundary, including authenticated sensing, projectile and turret caps, original deadlines and protected successor locks. Do not begin with global nearestObjects scans or a worker per bullet. Full allocation/capability source trace remains incomplete.
aimAndFireTrace20261021.validation: All three original PBO archives and six named extracted files hash-match protected inventory. Review JSON parsing and existing reference-boundary tests. Existing executable candidate remains aa-allocation-a7d45daa; no unchanged rebuild or Arma launch.
